info.title: Sonolith local API
info.description: A local JSON-RPC 2.0 API over a Unix domain socket (Linux) or a named pipe (Windows), one JSON message per line. Apps register and the user approves them; see SPEC.md for the full protocol. Server-to-client notifications are listed under `x-events`.

servers.name: linux
servers.summary: Unix domain socket; see discovery.json for the actual path.

servers.name: windows
servers.summary: Named pipe; read discovery.json for the actual name.

methods.name: app.info
methods.summary: Describes this Sonolith: API version, supported methods and topics, and the caller's session.
methods.description: Works before `session.hello`, so a client can check the API version first. `session` is null until the connection is authenticated.

methods.name: app.register
methods.summary: Asks the user to let this app connect. Returns `pending` at once; the outcome arrives as `registration.resolved`.

params.name: appId
params.description: The app's stable id. Use the same id in every version of the app.

params.name: name
params.description: The app's name as the user knows it. 1–48 characters.

params.name: description
params.description: What the app is, in one sentence. 1–200 characters.

params.name: publisher
params.description: Who makes the app: a person, a team or a company. 1–64 characters.

params.name: homepage
params.description: The app's web page. `https://` only, at most 200 characters.

params.name: icon
params.description: A square PNG data URI, at most 65536 characters. No remote URLs.

params.name: scopes
params.description: The scopes the app wants, each with `required` and a `reason`. Each scope at most once.

params.name: apiVersion
params.description: The API version the client was written for, for example `1.0`.

params.name: description
params.value: A status bar for Wayland compositors.

value.reason: To show the current song in your bar
To play, pause and skip from your bar

methods.description:
Sonolith identifies the calling process through the operating system, shows a system notification and a consent screen, and answers with `pending`. The client MUST keep this connection open until `registration.resolved` arrives on it: if the connection closes, Sonolith cancels the request and withdraws the consent screen. A request expires after 5 minutes.

Registering an `appId` that is already registered also goes through consent. When the user approves, the old token stops working (its connections get `session.revoked` with reason `replaced`) and the new one is sent.

A client MUST call this only after a user action (for example, a "Connect to Sonolith" button), never on its own at startup or after an error.

methods.name: app.requestScopes
methods.summary: Asks the user for more scopes. Shows a consent screen with only the new ones.

params.name: scopes
params.description: The additional scopes, each with `required` and a `reason`.

value.reason: To show the current lyric line in your bar

methods.description: Scopes the app already has are ignored. When nothing new is asked, the result is `granted` and nothing is shown. Otherwise the result is `pending` and the outcome arrives as `registration.resolved` with `kind` `scopes`; on approval `session.scopesChanged` follows. The connection MUST stay open while the request is pending. Call this only after a user action.

methods.name: app.unregister
methods.summary: Removes this app from Sonolith and invalidates its token.
methods.description: Call this from the app's "Disconnect from Sonolith" button, then delete the stored token. Sonolith answers, shows the user "<name> disconnected from Sonolith", closes this connection, and sends `session.revoked` (reason `unregistered`) to the app's other connections.

methods.name: session.hello
methods.summary: Authenticates the connection with the app's token.

params.name: appId
params.description: The id the app registered with.

params.name: token
params.description: The token from `registration.resolved`.

params.name: apiVersion
params.description: The API version the client was written for, for example `1.0`.

methods.description:
Send it first on every new connection. Sonolith checks the token and that the calling process has the app identity the user approved (section 6.6). Sonolith finishes `session.hello` before it reads the next message, so a client MAY send further requests right after it without waiting.

If the app identity changed (for example, the app was moved), the user is asked again and the call fails with `RegistrationPending` (reason `identityChanged`). Keep the connection open, wait for `registration.resolved` (`kind` `identity`), and on approval call `session.hello` again with the same token.

methods.name: events.subscribe
methods.summary: Subscribes the connection to event topics. Sends a snapshot of each new topic right after the response.

params.name: topics
params.description: The topics to add.

params.name: positionHz
params.description: `player.position` events per second while playing, 1–4. Default 1. Applies to the whole connection.

methods.description: Each topic needs the scope shown in the topic table; if any topic is not allowed, the whole call fails with `PermissionDenied` and nothing changes. Subscribing to a topic the connection already has is not an error (no new snapshot is sent for it). Subscriptions belong to the connection and end with it.

methods.name: events.unsubscribe
methods.summary: Removes topics from the connection's subscriptions.

params.name: topics
params.description: The topics to remove. Topics the connection does not have are ignored.

methods.name: player.getState
methods.summary: Returns the full player state.

methods.name: player.play
methods.summary: Starts or resumes playback.

methods.name: player.pause
methods.summary: Pauses playback. Pausing while paused is not an error.

methods.name: player.toggle
methods.summary: Plays when paused, pauses when playing.

methods.name: player.next
methods.summary: Skips to the next item in the queue.
methods.description: With repeat `all` it wraps to the first item; with autoplay on, Sonolith may first add related tracks.

methods.name: player.previous
methods.summary: Goes back like the Previous button: restarts the current item when more than 3 seconds have played, otherwise plays the previous item.

methods.name: player.seek
methods.summary: Seeks in the current item. Pass exactly one of `positionMs` and `offsetMs`.

params.name: positionMs
params.description: The position to seek to. Clamped to the item's length.

params.name: offsetMs
params.description: A relative jump; negative goes back. The result is clamped to the item.

methods.name: player.setVolume
methods.summary: Sets the volume, mute, or both. Pass at least one.

params.name: volume
params.description: The volume, 0–100. Setting a volume above 0 also unmutes.

params.name: muted
params.description: Mute or unmute.

methods.name: player.setShuffle
methods.summary: Turns shuffle on or off.

params.name: enabled
params.description: enabled

methods.name: player.setRepeat
methods.summary: Sets the repeat mode.

params.name: mode
params.description: mode

methods.name: player.setRate
methods.summary: Sets the playback speed for podcast episodes. Tracks always play at 1.

params.name: rate
params.description: One of the listed speeds.

methods.description: The speed is a Sonolith setting: it applies to the current episode at once and to every episode after it. Setting it while a track plays is allowed and takes effect at the next episode.

methods.name: player.playItem
methods.summary: Plays a track, episode, album, playlist or podcast. Replaces the queue.

params.name: item
params.description: What to play.

params.name: startId
params.description: For an album, playlist or podcast: the id of the track or episode to start with. Default: the first.

params.name: shuffle
params.description: For an album, playlist or podcast: shuffle it and turn shuffle on. Default false.

params.name: positionMs
params.description: Where to start in the first item.

methods.description: A track or episode starts a new queue with that item; with autoplay on, Sonolith continues with related tracks. An album, playlist or podcast fills the queue with its items in order (a podcast: its episodes, newest first). An episode resumes where the user left off unless `positionMs` is given.

methods.name: queue.get
methods.summary: Returns the queue, one page at a time.

params.name: fromIndex
params.description: Start at this index instead of 0, for example `currentIndex` to get what plays next. Ignored with `cursor`.

params.name: cursor
params.description: The `nextCursor` of the previous page. Omit for the first page.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of items. Default 50.

items.description: The entries of this page, in queue order.

methods.description: A cursor is tied to the queue's `revision`. If the queue changes between pages, the next page fails with `InvalidParams` (`cursorExpired`); start again.

methods.name: queue.add
methods.summary: Adds items to the end of the queue.

params.name: items
params.description: What to add, in order.

methods.description: An album, playlist or podcast adds all its items (at most 500). If autoplay entries are at the end, the new items go before them.

methods.name: queue.playNext
methods.summary: Inserts items right after the current item.

params.name: items
params.description: What to insert, in order.

methods.name: queue.move
methods.summary: Moves one entry to a new index.

params.name: entryId
params.description: The entry to move.

params.name: toIndex
params.description: Its index after the move. Clamped to the queue.

methods.name: queue.remove
methods.summary: Removes entries from the queue.

params.name: entryIds
params.description: The entries to remove.

methods.description: Removing the current entry plays the next one (or stops at the end). Unknown `entryIds` are ignored.

methods.name: queue.clear
methods.summary: Removes every entry except the current one. Playback continues.

methods.name: queue.setAutoplay
methods.summary: Turns autoplay on or off.

params.name: enabled
params.description: enabled

methods.description: Turning it off removes the autoplay entries that have not played yet.

methods.name: search.query
methods.summary: Searches YouTube Music.

params.name: query
params.description: The search text, 1–200 characters.

params.name: type
params.description: What to search for. Default `all`.

params.name: cursor
params.description: The `nextCursor` of the previous page. Omit for the first page.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of items. Default 50.

topResult.description: The best match when `type` is `all`, otherwise null.

methods.description: With `type` `all` the result is one page of mixed items (the best matches of each kind) plus an optional `topResult`, and `nextCursor` is always null. With any other `type` the results are paged and `topResult` is null.

methods.name: rating.set
methods.summary: Likes, dislikes or clears the rating of an item.

params.name: item
params.description: What to rate.

params.name: rating
params.description: rating

methods.description: For a track or episode, `like` adds it to liked songs. For an album, playlist or podcast, `like` saves it to the library and `none` removes it; `dislike` is not allowed for them (`InvalidParams`).

methods.name: lyrics.get
methods.summary: Returns lyrics with timings for the current item or a given track.

params.name: trackId
params.description: The track's id. Default: the current item.

methods.description: Sonolith searches its lyrics sources and returns the best result: word-synced over line-synced over unsynced. The lookup can take several seconds. Episodes have no lyrics (`notFound`). For the current item, `lyrics.changed` reports later improvements.

data.name: ParseError
data.meaning: The line is not valid UTF-8 JSON.

data.name: InvalidRequest
data.meaning: Not a valid JSON-RPC 2.0 request object, a batch, a message over the size limit (Sonolith then closes the connection), or a call not allowed in the connection's state.

data.name: MethodNotFound
data.meaning: No such method in this Sonolith.

data.name: InvalidParams
data.meaning: Missing, unknown or invalid parameters, or an expired cursor.

data.name: NotRegistered
data.meaning: The `appId` is not registered (never registered, unregistered, or removed by the user).

data.name: Unauthorized
data.meaning: The token is wrong or has been revoked.

data.name: PermissionDenied
data.meaning: The app lacks the scope in `data.scope`.

data.name: RegistrationPending
data.meaning: A request is already waiting for the user, or the app identity changed and the user must approve it again.

data.name: RegistrationDenied
data.meaning: The user denied a recent request; asking again is on hold.

data.name: NotSignedIn
data.meaning: The method needs a YouTube account and the user is signed out.

data.name: NotFound
data.meaning: The item does not exist or is not visible to this app.

data.name: RateLimited
data.meaning: The app exceeded its rate limit or its in-flight request limit.

data.name: Unavailable
data.meaning: The action is not possible right now (for example, nothing is playing, or Sonolith is still starting).

data.name: Timeout
data.meaning: YouTube, a lyrics source or Sonolith did not answer in time.

data.name: SessionRequired
data.meaning: The method needs an authenticated session.

data.name: UnsupportedVersion
data.meaning: Sonolith does not support the requested API major version.

x-events.name: player.stateChanged
x-events.summary: The player state changed (anything but the position moving on).
x-events.description: Sent when any `PlayerState` field changes, except `positionMs` and `positionAt` advancing during playback. A seek sends it. Bursts are coalesced to at most 10 per second; the last state always arrives.

x-events.name: player.trackChanged
x-events.summary: A different item became current (or none).
x-events.description: A different item became current (or none).

item.description: The new current item, or null.

x-events.name: player.position
x-events.summary: The playback position, at the subscribed rate while playing.
x-events.description: Sent `positionHz` times per second while playing, and once on pause, seek and item change. Not sent while paused or stopped. Between events, extrapolate: `positionMs + (now - positionAt) * rate`.

x-events.name: player.volumeChanged
x-events.description: Bursts (for example, dragging the volume slider) are coalesced to at most 10 per second.

x-events.name: queue.changed
x-events.summary: The queue's entries or current index changed.
x-events.description: Carries the summary only; call `queue.get` for the entries. Bursts are coalesced; `revision` tells whether a copy is current.

x-events.name: lyrics.changed
x-events.summary: Lyrics for the current item were found, improved, or cleared.
x-events.description: Sent when the current item changes (`status` `notFound` with `lyrics` null until lyrics are found), when lyrics are found, and when a better tier replaces them. The snapshot on subscribe carries what Sonolith has now.

x-events.name: lyrics.line
x-events.description: Sent while playing synced lyrics (tier `word` or `line`), when a line starts, when a break starts (`lineIndex` null), and right after a seek.

x-events.name: lyrics.word
x-events.description: Sent while playing `word`-tier lyrics, for main and background vocals. This topic is busy (often 3–8 events per second); for smooth karaoke, animate from `player.position` and the word timings instead, and use this only to correct drift.

x-events.name: account.changed
x-events.summary: The user signed in to or out of YouTube in Sonolith.
x-events.description: The user signed in to or out of YouTube in Sonolith.

x-events.name: registration.resolved
x-events.summary: A registration, scope or identity request was answered or expired.
x-events.description: Sent only to the connection that made the request; no subscription needed. On `approved` with a `token`, store the token before anything else, then call `session.hello`.

x-events.name: session.revoked
x-events.summary: The app's access was revoked. Sonolith closes the connection right after.
x-events.description: Sent to every connection of the app; no subscription needed. The client MUST stop using Sonolith, delete the stored token, and tell the user "Disconnected from Sonolith".

x-events.name: session.scopesChanged
x-events.description: Sent to every connection of the app; no subscription needed. Subscriptions to topics whose scope was removed end without further notice.

x-scopes.label: See what's playing
x-scopes.allows: The current item, playback state, position, volume, shuffle and repeat.

x-scopes.label: Control playback
x-scopes.allows: Play, pause, skip, seek, volume, shuffle, repeat, episode speed, and starting a track, album, playlist or episode (which replaces the queue).

x-scopes.label: Change your queue
x-scopes.allows: Add, move and remove queue entries, clear the queue, turn autoplay on or off.

x-scopes.label: Access your library
x-scopes.allows: Playlists, liked songs, albums, artists, podcasts, episodes for later, history, and your ratings in returned items.

x-scopes.label: Change your library
x-scopes.allows: Create, rename and delete playlists, add and remove playlist items, like and dislike, save albums, playlists and podcasts.

x-scopes.label: Search YouTube Music
x-scopes.allows: Search, suggestions, and album, artist, podcast, episode and public playlist pages.

x-scopes.label: Show lyrics
x-scopes.allows: Lyrics with timings for the current or any track, and live line and word events.

x-rate-classes.name: network
x-rate-classes.applies: Reads that may reach YouTube or a lyrics source.

x-rate-classes.name: account
x-rate-classes.limit: 1 every 2 seconds, bursts of 5 (30 per minute)
x-rate-classes.applies: Changes to the user's YouTube account.

x-rate-classes.name: auth
x-rate-classes.limit: 1 per second, bursts of 5, per connection
